g.text: BC-03 Catalog & Commercial Policy — Tactical Domain Model
+resolve(sku: SKU, prices: PriceListItem, terms: CustomerTerms, promotion: Promotion [0..1]): ResolvedOfferSnapshot
Product and SKU are independent Aggregate Roots linked by identity.
PriceList owns pricing items; Promotion policy selects at most one promotion.
CustomerAccount is a typed BC-02 reference; no cross-context composition.
